wiki.title: Dialogue Editor Wiki
wiki.intro: Dialogue Editor is the main place to build NPC dialogue sets in Dochi Editor. It handles node flow, branch choices, conditions, actions, GUI mapping, and runtime preview inside Minecraft.
wiki.quick_start.title: Quick Start
wiki.quick_start.step.1: Open Dochi Editor inside a Minecraft world.
wiki.quick_start.step.2: Choose Dialogue Editor from the main menu.
wiki.quick_start.step.4: Add the first node and fill in its text.
wiki.quick_start.step.6: Connect a GUI JSON if the dialogue uses a custom screen.
wiki.quick_start.step.8: Test the branch flow in runtime and adjust the order if needed.
wiki.requirements.title: Requirements
wiki.requirements.dochi_editor: Provides the editor UI and file bridge.
wiki.requirements.customnpcs: Stores dialogue JSON and runtime data.
wiki.requirements.cnpcextended: Supports extended GUI and HTML-based runtime features.
wiki.requirements.image_assets: Provide screenshots, diagrams, and layout callouts for the wiki.
wiki.paths.title: Folder Rules
wiki.layout.title: Screen Layout
wiki.layout.node_list: Shows nodes, search, and branch order.
wiki.layout.canvas: Holds the dialogue text, choice wiring, and route preview.
wiki.layout.inspector: Edits the selected node, choice, condition, or action.
wiki.layout.toolbar: Saves, imports, exports, and opens helper panels.
wiki.workflow.title: Node Workflow
wiki.workflow.step.1: Create the dialogue set and give it a stable ID.
wiki.workflow.step.2: Add the first node and write the opening line.
wiki.workflow.step.3: Add choices that point to the next node or action.
wiki.workflow.step.4: Attach conditions where a choice or node should only appear sometimes.
wiki.workflow.step.5: Add actions for rewards, commands, sounds, or state changes.
wiki.workflow.step.6: Preview the path and confirm the branch order feels natural.
wiki.workflow.step.7: Export the finished JSON and keep a backup copy before larger edits.
wiki.choices.title: Choices And Branching
wiki.choices.choice_text: The line the player sees in the menu.
wiki.choices.target_node: Where the branch continues after selection.
wiki.choices.action: What should happen after the choice is picked.
wiki.conditions.title: Conditions
wiki.conditions.tags: Gate branches by server or quest state.
wiki.conditions.inventory: Show a branch only when the player has a required item.
wiki.conditions.currency: Check whether the player can afford a branch or reward.
wiki.actions.title: Actions And FX
wiki.actions.command: Trigger server commands or scripted behavior.
wiki.actions.item: Give, remove, or consume an item.
wiki.actions.sound: Play a sound cue on branch entry or exit.
wiki.actions.text_fx: Control color, pacing, emphasis, or reveal timing.
wiki.actions.state_change: Update tags, counters, or flags for later branches.
wiki.actions.gui_open: Send the player into a custom GUI screen.
wiki.gui.title: GUI Mapping
wiki.gui.gui_json_path: Match the exported GUI file that the dialogue should open.
wiki.gui.runtime_path: Keep the runtime asset path aligned with the source file location.
wiki.gui.preview_path: The preview image path can differ from the runtime asset path, so check both.
wiki.gui.trigger: Decide whether the GUI opens on node entry or on a choice action.
wiki.images.title: Images And Screenshots
wiki.images.note: The wiki accepts PNG, JPEG, GIF, and SVG files. Put them in wiki/assets/dialogue-editor/ and use descriptive file names such as dialogue-editor-node-tree.png.
wiki.images.embed_example: You can embed images with normal Markdown syntax.
wiki.images.sample_note: The two SVG files in this folder are sample diagrams. Replace them with real screenshots when you capture the editor UI.
wiki.import_export.title: Import And Export
wiki.import_export.note: Import is useful when you are moving from a sample file or an older draft. Export is the final save step before you test in-game.
wiki.import_export.backup: Before large edits, keep a backup of the entire dc_data/dc_dialogues folder.
wiki.import_export.compare: If a dialogue tree becomes hard to understand, export a clean copy and compare the two versions instead of editing in place forever.
wiki.troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
wiki.troubleshooting.choice_missing: A condition hides it or the branch target is wrong.
wiki.troubleshooting.flow_broken: A node points to the wrong branch or the order is unclear.
wiki.troubleshooting.gui_missing: The GUI JSON path does not match the exported file.
wiki.troubleshooting.image_missing: The path is wrong or the file is not in a supported format.
wiki.troubleshooting.export_failed: Required IDs or node fields are missing.
wiki.troubleshooting.locale_drift: One locale file was updated without the other.
wiki.recommended.title: Recommended Workflow
wiki.recommended.step.1: Sketch the dialogue tree on paper or in a note first.
wiki.recommended.step.2: Create the nodes and the main happy-path branch.
wiki.recommended.step.3: Add conditions only after the base flow works.
wiki.recommended.step.4: Add actions and GUI mapping once the branch order feels stable.
wiki.recommended.step.5: Embed images after the text is readable.
wiki.recommended.step.6: Export, test in-game, and trim any confusing branch names.
wiki.recommended.step.7: Update both locale files at the same time when text changes.
